steps.caption: JobCam
steps.narration: This is JobCam. Every job-site photo and video your crew takes, filed to its project with the time and the place it was shot.

steps.caption: Newest shots first
steps.narration: Recent shows the newest shots first, across every job you have going.

steps.caption: Open a shot
steps.narration: Open one and it opens over the feed.

steps.caption: When, who, which project
steps.narration: Under it you see when it was taken, who took it, and the project it belongs to. That is your record of what was done, and when.

steps.caption: What the client may see
steps.narration: You decide what the client sees. Switch a shot on and it shows in their portal; leave it off and it stays with the team.

steps.caption: Star it
steps.narration: Star the ones that matter, like the before and after you will want again.

steps.caption: Back to the feed
steps.narration: Close brings you back to the feed.

steps.caption: Open camera
steps.narration: On site, Open camera shoots straight from your phone, stamped the moment it is taken.

steps.caption: Timeline
steps.narration: Timeline reads the same shots day by day, with the project named beside each day.

steps.caption: A job as a story
steps.narration: So a job reads as a story: what the crew did, and on which day.

steps.caption: Menu: JobCam
steps.narration: You will find JobCam in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: JobCam in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of JobCam in ConstructHUB: every job-site photo and video filed to its project with the time and place it was shot, what each shot keeps, choosing what the client may see, shooting from your phone on site, and the day-by-day timeline.
